page_title: Enconvo — The assistant your Mac was promised.

summary.name: Enconvo
summary.one_liner: Enconvo is a native macOS AI agent that sees your screen, works inside your Mac apps, and handles writing, research, dictation, and automation.
use_cases: write and fix text in any app
automate Mac apps and browser tasks
dictate text into any app by voice
run local models offline on a Mac
control Mac from phone or messaging apps
summary.what_it_does: Enconvo is a native macOS AI assistant that understands screen and selected-text context and works beside your apps. It offers chat with many AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, and local models via MLX, Ollama, or LM Studio). Its agent mode can plan, use tools and skills, and use Computer Use and Browser Use to click, type, and fill forms. Other features include PopBar (a toolbar on selected text), SmartBar, dictation, read-aloud, meeting recording, knowledge bases, and workflows with a visual editor. The page also lists over 80 open-source plugins, MCP server support, and an iPhone/Android companion app.
notable: Native macOS app (not Electron) supporting Intel and Apple Silicon, macOS 14+
Bring your own API keys or local models for unlimited AI usage on every tier, including free
PopBar shows one-click actions when you select text in any app
Plugins, MCP servers, skills and workflows extend the agent; extensions are open source on GitHub
caveats: Paid tiers: one-time licenses from $49 or Cloud plans from $10/month; free tier has limits on meeting recording, live captions, knowledge bases, workflows, and scheduled tasks
Mobile app is in beta (iPhone via TestFlight); Remote phone access and sync across Macs require a paid plan
The core app is not open source; only its extensions are
